environment.description: Same Laravel application deployed on AWS ECS with an NLB (Network Load Balancer) operating in TCP passthrough mode on port 443. TLS termination occurs at the Envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) running as a reverse proxy within the ECS task. The Envoy listener is configured with a downstream TLS transport socket requiring client certificate verification against an internal CA bundle (require_client_certificate: true in the DownstreamTlsContext). The filter chain includes an HTTP connection manager with http1_settings.allow_chunked_length set to false and the envoy.filters.http.header_mutation filter stripping Transfer-Encoding headers when Content-Length is also present. The Envoy access log format includes %RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS% for audit. Route matching requires the x-ssl-client-s-dn header injected by Envoy after successful mTLS handshake to contain a CN matching the pattern 'service-*.internal.corp'. Without a valid client certificate signed by the internal CA, the TLS handshake fails at the Envoy layer before any HTTP parsing occurs.

config.nlb_listener: TCP:443 passthrough, no TLS termination at NLB
config.client_cert_distribution: HashiCorp Vault PKI engine, 24h TTL, role restricted to internal services
